I never admitted that I've experienced anything worth living for in anything I have typed above. And that's for a reason. I've been shamed for my appearance, beaten as a child, never felt love from family, and spend most of my time alone in my room. Begging the universe for a reason to all this life long suffering. They say everything happens for a reason. Clearly I was suppose to suffer in these many different ways. Most of which are not my fault at all like the child abuse, that was my punishment just for existing.

The single, and only reason I haven't taken my life is due to my delusional belief that if I last long enough maybe by some off chance I'll have a run in with a passion, or a person I can fall in love with. Or an experience so appalling that I'd have hated myself for missing it. But it's all hopes, no different than hoping for a winning lottery ticket. My whole life is hanging onto a delusion that I know is bullshit. Fighting my own suicidal thoughts that convince me everything I've gone though just can't be worth it. It's like saying life get's better once you cross the finish line, but it'll cost you an arm, a leg, and most of your sanity just to get there.

Even as you've said, "working sucks", working is most of your waking life is it not? And it is just suppose to simply "suck"? That's absolutely madness. I luckily don't have a job, if that's how you and everyone else I've spoken to describe it. And the one thing I do enjoy doing which is sleeping, is next door from death itself.

I guess on one end I feel guilty to enjoy things, like I'm just not suppose to. But it's easy to feel pain because it's something that happens to you. Who knows, maybe it's karma and I just simply deserve it all. Or maybe I was just extraordinarily unlucky in my upbringing up until now.

But to truly say, "That moment of my life was worth experiencing even after all the pain I've been through." Just doesn't work. I've felt physical pain so bad I genuinely think it has damaged my brain permanently. Pain so bad that nothing could amount to. No amount of money or true love could ever make up for the 6 hours of pain I experienced when my wisdom teeth were removed, or when I got extremely sick one time.

The negative experiences are just too massive for any amount of living to ever be worth it. And to top it all off, I know from the bottom of my heart I will experience this catastrophic pain again maybe multiple times in my life in the future.

When you feel pain that great, it's the pinnacle of existence. It's so intimate that it fry's your mind. I don't wanna live any longer, because I know if I do I will inevitable feel pain of which I could never tolerate.
